label: Content Sheet
title: Content Sheet
summary: Use a Content Sheet to show a short panel from the bottom of the screen, such as a month’s transactions or a payment choice.
corePrinciple: It grows to fit its content; the screen decides when it shows.

anatomy.title: One slot under an optional title
anatomy.description: A white sheet with 20 px top corners holds one slot of content and an optional centred title. In a screen it docks to the bottom and spans the full width.
blocks: Optional and centred; it stays put while the content scrolls.
Any content; the sheet grows to fit it.
White, with 20 px top corners and no handle.

configuration.title: A title and one slot
configuration.description: Add a title when the content needs a name. The slot takes any content, and the sheet’s height follows it.

states.title: Shown or hidden
states.description: The screen shows and hides the sheet: it springs up from the bottom and back down. A hidden sheet waits below the screen, out of the Tab order and hidden from screen readers.
blocks: Over a dimmed screen, docked to the bottom.
Below the screen; only the screen shows.

examples.title: Hidden
examples.description: Below the screen; only the screen shows.

sizing.title: Full width, as tall as its content
sizing.description: The sheet spans its screen and adds 12 px above and 41 px below the content, with 8 px between the title and the content. It never sets a height: it grows with the content up to 70% of its screen, then the content scrolls under the title.

content.title: Name it, and keep it to one task
content.description: Title the sheet with what it holds, such as a month or a choice, in a few words. Keep the content short enough to read without scrolling; longer content deserves its own screen.

inContext.title: Choosing how to pay
inContext.description: The payment screen opens the sheet from Change payment method. Choosing an option, or tapping the dimmed screen, closes it; the screen keeps the choice.

sources.title: Use the public Content Sheet contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (12 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Content Sheet is one 360 × 350 component with a fixed header and a slot. In the package, as in Figma, the title stays fixed 8 px above the content, and the items in the slot are 8 px apart. The title is a page heading. The sheet has no role, scrim, or close control of its own; a hidden sheet leaves the Tab order and is hidden from screen readers. Its 70% height limit is measured against its screen. The examples dim their screens with Coin Overlay, which leaves keyboard focus on the page.
